# owner: platform
"""Contact sheet rows for substitute teachers."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from rosterkit.models import Student


# ---
def format_contact_row(student: Student) -> str:
    name = student.display_name
    if not student.email:
        raise ValueError(f"no email for student: {name}")
    return f"{name:<20} {student.section:<8} {student.email}"


# ---
def contact_sheet(students: Iterable[Student]) -> List[str]:
    """Rows sorted by name; empty input or a missing email fails."""
    ordered = sorted(students, key=lambda item: item.display_name)
    if not ordered:
        raise ValueError("no students for the contact sheet")
    return [format_contact_row(item) for item in ordered]
after.tests/test_contacts.py:
# owner: platform
import unittest

from rosterkit.contacts import contact_sheet
from rosterkit.models import Student

ADAMS = Student("1", "Adams", "Zoe", "A", "zoe@example.org")
BAKER = Student("2", "Baker", "Al", "B", "al@example.org")


class ContactSheetTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rows_are_sorted_and_aligned(self):
        rows = contact_sheet([BAKER, ADAMS])
        self.assertTrue(rows[0].startswith("Adams, Zoe"))
        self.assertTrue(rows[1].startswith("Baker, Al"))
        self.assertEqual(rows[0].index("A "), rows[1].index("B "))

    def test_row_has_section_and_email(self):
        row = contact_sheet([ADAMS])[0]
        self.assertIn("zoe@example.org", row)

    def test_missing_email_names_student(self):
        nomail = Student("3", "Cruz", "Ana", "A")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Cruz, Ana"):
            contact_sheet([ADAMS, nomail])

    def test_empty_list_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            contact_sheet([])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
